name: Arcade
summary: Arcade is a runtime that lets agents act in services like Gmail, Slack and GitHub on behalf of a specific user, handling OAuth, token storage and per-action authorization. It runs MCP servers, offers MCP gateways for governance and ships thousands of prebuilt tools. Arcade acquired the Smithery MCP registry in August 2026.
facts: Arcade Cloud, AWS/Azure marketplace, self-hosted with Helm
Free tier (2,000 auth events and 2,000 tool calls/month); Team $25/month plus usage
goodFor: Agents acting as individual users in SaaS apps
watchOut: Billed per auth event and per tool call
VPC and air-gapped deployment are Enterprise only
